verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS platform with a developer CLI and MCP server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking opt-out in Gusto's web product, API, CLI, or MCP server. The registered-agent mail privacy and robots.txt content signals are different controls and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
